_readme: S359 SkyMoss, 2026-10-10. Long Beach City is the next college after RCCD (Sam's ruling on Sheet 59 card 1). Its registry row holds https://www.lbcc.edu/college-catalog, the college's page about its catalog (census platform courseleaf, 391 programs Active or Approved), so the college read needs the catalog's own address and its sitemap before a capture. This read loads that page and prints its catalog links, then the catalog's front page and sitemap where the links name them. Page loads only, no model call.

questions.catalog_address: The address of the current catalog itself (a CourseLeaf host such as catalog.lbcc.edu), and its year.
questions.sitemap: Whether the catalog publishes /sitemap.xml and how its program pages are addressed.
